saved_runs.purpose: Inspect an existing actual OpenAI/DeepSeek collaboration result.
Inspect failure presentation and historical identity.

observations.result: Clicking Reviewer exposed node: review while the Agent editor still selected proposer. The graph and editor use independent selection.

observations.result: Run entry displays immediate required-field errors; saved sequence result exposes draft/review aggregate; history lacks visible date/task summaries.
Inspect run begins with technical events; Escape did not close the panel; its Close button did.
observations.verification: Live interaction; complementary panel/focus behavior also inspected in source.

observations.result: Unavailable local services coincided with catalog failure; empty-state and operator-connected labels were misleading. During later definition loading a source-repair fallback appeared.
observations.verification: Live observation; no inference of a backend catalog implementation defect.

source_only_failure_paths: Unapplied field buffers omitted from dirty/readiness state
Draft/buffer loss on experiment or agent/node changes
Immutable revision conflict after editing before deriving a revision
Sequence mapping metadata rejected and sequence final-result setting ignored
Model/effort compatibility can strand temperature overrides
Result response.json then JSON.stringify can lose numeric precision and source bytes
Use latest server limits restores cached values
Extension field-name heuristics can select inappropriate editors

geometry.qualification: One recorded desktop layout, not a responsive benchmark. Counts and geometry for descendants of closed disclosures were excluded because DOM rectangles alone do not establish visible controls.
